title: Glowing paper plane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffbe0' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#fff59a' stop-opacity='0.15'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff59a' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe866'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- outer soft glow -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='46' r='38' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- motion trail -->
  <g stroke='#ffe866' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'>
    <line x1='18' y1='70' x2='32' y2='62'/>
    <line x1='14' y1='62' x2='28' y2='55'/>
    <line x1='22' y1='78' x2='35' y2='69'/>
  </g>
  <!-- paper plane - main body (top wing) -->
  <polygon points='78,28 30,58 52,54' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- wing crease line (lighter shade) -->
  <line x1='78' y1='28' x2='52' y2='54' stroke='#fff8cc' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bottom wing -->
  <polygon points='78,28 52,54 44,66' fill='#ffd633'/>
  <!-- fold highlight -->
  <line x1='78' y1='28' x2='44' y2='66' stroke='#fff59a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail fold -->
  <polygon points='30,58 52,54 44,66' fill='#ffe866'/>
  <!-- wing tip highlight -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='28' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- sparkle 1 -->
  <g transform='translate(74,20)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-5' x2='0' y2='5' stroke='#fff8cc' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-5' y1='0' x2='5' y2='0' stroke='#fff8cc' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 2 -->
  <g transform='translate(60,16)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-3.5' x2='0' y2='3.5' stroke='#ffe866' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3.5' y1='0' x2='3.5' y2='0' stroke='#ffe866' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 3 -->
  <g transform='translate(84,42)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-3' x2='0' y2='3' stroke='#fff59a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3' y1='0' x2='3' y2='0' stroke='#fff59a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
